Not quite. The evidence supports a narrower statement: no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected on this asset between 2021-01-01 and 2025-12-31. Valid observations covered the whole asset (fraction 1.0).

It does not show that tree cover is unchanged. Smaller changes (under 0.5 ha), changes at edges, or changes narrower than the 30 m pixels could be missed. It also covers only loss, so it says nothing about gain or regrowth, and only the 2021–2025 period.

For context, JRC data show about 43.3 ha of forest in 2020 (11.55% of the 374.8 ha asset).

The evidence also makes no regulatory or compliance finding, such as deforestation-free status.
